# Winfred Quek ,  Singapore Property Advisor

> Investor-minded property advisor in Singapore. CEA R073319H. Crestbrick / PropNex Realty. Nine years of experience, 5 properties before 30, the Property Portfolio Analysis methodology. Specialises in HDB upgraders, ownership restructuring (decoupling), ABSD planning, foreign-buyer strategy, and family-office property briefs.

- [All calculators](https://winfredquek.com/tools): Index of every free calculator on the site.
- [ABSD calculator](https://winfredquek.com/tools/absd): Singapore ABSD 2026 by buyer profile (SC, PR, foreigner, entity, joint).
- [BSD calculator](https://winfredquek.com/tools/bsd): Buyer's Stamp Duty tiered breakdown for residential and non-residential.
- [Affordability calculator](https://winfredquek.com/tools/affordability): TDSR / MSR-based max loan and max purchase price with MAS 4% stress-test.
- [Restructuring calculator](https://winfredquek.com/tools/restructuring): Decoupling / ownership-restructuring break-even ,  BSD-on-transfer vs ABSD saved.

## Area pages (programmatic ,  MRT × school catchment)

- [Area landing pages](https://winfredquek.com/area/): ~60 pages, one per (MRT station × top primary school within 1 km) pair. Distance band, Phase 2A/2B/2C registration, walk time, BTO/condo options nearby. Examples: /area/punggol-punggol-primary, /area/tampines-tampines-primary, /area/bishan-catholic-high.
